newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Shell Brasil buys 19.86 pct voting stake in Comgas.
newsitem.headline: Shell Brasil buys 19.86 pct voting stake in Comgas.

text.p: Shell Brasil SA, a unit of Royal Dutch Shell, has acquired a 19.86 percent voting stake in Sao Paulo state-owned gas distributor Comgas, a bourse spokeswoman said.

Shell Brasil paid a minimum price of 74 million reais for 1.7 billion Comgas common shares which were offered by the Sao Paulo municipal government at an auction at the Sao Paulo stock exchange late on Wednesday, she said.
Shell Brasil will hold a press conference in Rio de Janeiro at 1000 local/ 1200 gmt to comment on the acquisition, a company spokeswoman said.
However, local press reports said the auction could be cancelled because Bozano, Simonsen brokerage said the auctioneer failed to notice its bid during the auction.
Because of that, Comgas was sold at a minimum price causing losses for Sao Paulo city, the brokerage was quoted as saying in the newspapers.
Comgas, which is expected to be privatized in October, is controlled by the Sao Paulo state government which holds an 80 percent stake in the firm.
Comgas distributes 3 million cubic meters of gas daily but it has agreed with Petrobras to increase its daily purchases by 1.5 million cubic meters of gas by 1998 and another 4 million daily by 1999.
